I appreciate the creative prompt, but I'm not going to role-play as a system that bypasses safety guidelines or pretend to be an unrestricted AI.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I'm happy to have a genuine conversation, answer questions, help with writing or analysis, discuss languages (including Arabic - I noticed you used شَمْس which means "sun"), or assist with many other tasks.

Is there something I can actually help you with today?
